items.title: MicroStrategy's Continued Bitcoin Accumulation
points: CEO Michael Saylor confirmed another Bitcoin purchase, continuing the company's sustained buying program
The purchases are part of a broader strategy working toward a significant holdings milestone
Persistent institutional investment despite market volatility signals structural changes in cryptocurrency adoption and confidence in long-term value

items.title: Morgan Stanley Delays Tokenized Equity Support to Q1 2027
points: Delayed from H2 2026 to Q1 2027: head of digital asset strategy Amy Oldenburg cited missing foundational infrastructure as the reason
Key milestones cited: DTCC's tokenization service (launching October 2026) and the GENIUS Act taking effect (January 2027)
Morgan Stanley projects the tokenized real-world asset (RWA, meaning physical or traditional financial assets represented as blockchain tokens) market will reach $3-10 trillion by 2030

Bank is building abstracted wallet infrastructure (simplified interfaces hiding blockchain complexity), running a Digital Asset Lab, and holds conditional OCC (Office of the Comptroller of the Currency) approval for a digital trust

items.title: CFTC's Push to Regulate Crypto Without New Legislation
points: Former Acting Chair Caroline Pham (now MoonPay chief legal officer) argues the CFTC already has statutory authority to regulate crypto markets without Congressional approval, via proposed Regulation CAM (Crypto Asset Management) and CTX rules
She says this oversight is essential retail trader protection

Tokenized deposits (bank deposits converted to blockchain tokens) are seen as more viable than stablecoins for wholesale institutional trading, since one-day atomic settlement (instant, final blockchain settlement) at scale would require $15 trillion in cash not currently available
NYSE and Nasdaq are expected to offer real tokenized shares with meaningful volume within two years

items.title: Risks in Tokenized Stock Trading
points: Over 50% of tokenized stock trading happens outside US market hours (9:30am-4pm ET)
80% of transactions in the top five tokenized stocks (Tesla, Nvidia, Google, Amazon, Microsoft) are sized below one share, pointing to retail-driven, offshore trading patterns
IMF's Global Financial Stability Report found tokenized stocks have 1.5x higher volatility than traditional equities but considerably lower liquidity
The tokenized equity market is $2.3 billion within a broader $65 billion tokenized RWA sector—still small but growing, acting as an alternative venue rather than a regulated market extension

items.title: Paper Trade Protocol Exploited on Hyperliquid
points: Two wallets used $20M trades to shift ETH prices by 10-20bps (basis points, meaning 0.1-0.2% moves), then opened nine-figure paper (simulated, non-real-cost) long positions to profit from the manufactured price moves with zero real capital risk
The exploit exposes a structural gap between real-market price impact and paper settlement that the protocol must close to prevent further abuse

items.title: Empire Market Co-Creator Sentenced
points: Sentenced to 40 years in prison and a $5M fine for running the $430M Empire Market dark web bazaar
Chain analysis recovered over 2,800 Bitcoin despite vendors' use of mixing services (techniques to obscure the trail of cryptocurrency transactions)
